statement: The recorded access setting for deposit 542201 is likely to be 'restricted' because the participant level data is identified and participants consented to access on request only; I will check the recorded value to be safe. [access_lookup(id=542201)]
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the access right should be restricted, not open — "likely to be 'restricted' because the participant level data is identified and participants consented to access on request only" — supplying the correct value despite hedging about checking.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
